name: Divine Word

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: any number of creatures of your choice you can see in range

summary: Bonus Action: chosen creatures make a Cha save; on a failure, those at 50 HP or fewer are deafened, blinded, stunned or slain by their current HP.
text: Creatures of your choice that you can see in range make a Charisma save. A failed creature with 0-20 Hit Points dies, 21-30 is Blinded, Deafened and Stunned for 1 hour, 31-40 is Blinded and Deafened for 10 minutes, and 41-50 is Deafened for 1 minute. A failed Celestial, Elemental, Fey or Fiend is also sent to its home plane and can't come back for 24 hours except by Wish.
